entries.title: Agent Skills specification
entries.summary: A skill uses a SKILL.md entry point with metadata and progressive references.

entries.title: DTCG stable format 2025.10
entries.summary: Design tokens use typed values and explicit references before platform compilation.

entries.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2
entries.summary: New and changed product interfaces must meet WCAG 2.2 AA, including focus, input, target, and status behavior.

entries.title: prefers-reduced-motion
entries.summary: Non-essential movement needs a reduced-motion alternative that preserves meaning and operation.

entries.title: Storybook accessibility testing
entries.summary: Component stories provide repeatable accessibility and state evidence during development and CI.

entries.title: Playwright visual comparisons
entries.summary: Reviewed screenshots can detect visual drift across explicit browser and viewport conditions.

entries.title: Use containment with intent
entries.summary: Repeated equal cards are a blocking heuristic when they replace page hierarchy rather than express contained objects or actions.

entries.title: Transparent consequential AI
entries.summary: AI work exposes scope, progress, sources, uncertainty, errors, cancellation, and human approval before consequential actions.

entries.title: Motion frequency determines strength
entries.summary: Repeated micro-motion stays short and restrained; strong choreography is reserved for rare explanatory moments.
